clips.title: The story
paras: Grieving the loss of her sister Anilia, the dryad Illiyana at the Shrine of Aessina seeks vengeance against the satyrs lurking in Ashenvale. She asks Alliance champions to cull the corrupted creatures and return with their horns as proof of their downfall.

Dryads are typically playful and serene forest spirits, deeply bonded to nature and elusive to mortals. The brutal slaying of Anilia shatters this tranquility for Illiyana, who dwells at the Shrine of Aessina. Pushed past her carefree nature into unfamiliar sorrow, she turns to travelers of the Alliance to strike down the demonic beasts responsible.

Satyrs represent a dark, twisted branch of ancient night elf ancestry, irrevocably tainted by demonic energy during the War of the Ancients. Lurking in defiled groves across Ashenvale, these vile servants of the Burning Legion actively prey upon the denizens of the woods. Taking their horns serves not only as proof of vengeance, but strikes a direct blow against the fel presence encroaching upon eastern Ashenvale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... Sad.
I know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, kind traveler. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
